measurement.implementation: Documented bounded C# algorithm over ML.NET PCA vectors

space.scope: Shared process snapshot after assessment; lifetime peak includes previous pipelines/native state. Artifact bytes are compressed ML.NET pipelines or transductive sample JSON; parameter bytes exclude gradients, optimizer and activations.

measurement.sampling: At most 256 training passages ranked by SHA256(seed|sample|id); no heldout input used.

assertions: The full supplied prepared corpus was read without labels and its SHA256 remained unchanged.
Seed-42 duplicate-aware split was independently reproduced; normalized duplicate passages do not cross the holdout.
The report records semantic accuracy as unavailable for unlabeled book passages.
Memory values are finite shared-process snapshots, not isolated model-memory measurements.
All at-most-256 private sample vectors have 32 finite PCA coordinates; sample selection SHA256 independently matches training rows.
Artifact assignments agree with aggregate cluster/noise counts and fixed algorithm settings.
Sample silhouette/noise describe transductive training geometry; no heldout accuracy is asserted.
records.timing_scope: Fresh integration run: one shared five-algorithm fit per language plus independent split/vocabulary verification; not a controlled performance benchmark.
records.accuracy_scope: Books are unlabeled. These assertions test integration, traceability and finite geometry/reconstruction, not semantic prediction correctness.

measurement.implementation: TorchSharp CPU neural model in C#

space.scope: Shared process snapshot after assessment; lifetime peak includes previous pipelines/native state. Artifact bytes are compressed ML.NET pipelines or transductive sample JSON; parameter bytes exclude gradients, optimizer and activations.

metadata.upstream_transform_contract: caller fits vectorizer/PCA/scaling on training rows only
metadata.timing: fit includes model creation/optimization; prediction includes reconstruction, MSE, and latent encoding; native init and one training-input warmup excluded
metadata.memory_measure: maximum process working-set sample at batch boundaries; not isolated model memory

assertions: The full supplied prepared corpus was read without labels and its SHA256 remained unchanged.
Seed-42 duplicate-aware split was independently reproduced; normalized duplicate passages do not cross the holdout.
The report records semantic accuracy as unavailable for unlabeled book passages.

Heldout reconstruction and constant-zero/training-mean baseline MSE are finite; no learned quality threshold or prose decoding is claimed.
The 6,320 parameters are measured; model weights and heldout encodings are not exported.

records.accuracy_scope: Books are unlabeled. These assertions test integration, traceability and finite geometry/reconstruction, not semantic prediction correctness.
